item.title: Exiled Iranian warns regime was 'aggressively patient threat waiting to pounce' on America
item.summary: Iranian exile Nazee Moinian defends U.S. strikes on Iran, pushing back on anti-war protesters and arguing the military action was justified.

item.title: Colts sign Daniel Jones to record-breaking contract as he recovers from Achilles injury: reports
item.summary: Colts reportedly sign Daniel Jones to a two-year, $88 million contract worth up to $100 million, making it the largest two-year deal in NFL history.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: Trump's SAVE Act ultimatum runs into Senate reality
item.summary: Trump demands Senate Republicans pass SAVE America Act requiring proof of citizenship to vote, but GOP leaders say they lack votes for filibuster.

item.title: House GOP leader launches Senate bid as Trump taps Markwayne Mullin for DHS
item.summary: GOP Rep. Kevin Hern launches his Oklahoma Senate bid to replace DHS nominee Markwayne Mullin, vowing to be a "loyal ally" to President Trump’s "America First" agenda.

item.title: New York governor warned to fix race-based college program or be taken to court
item.summary: New York faces potential lawsuit over college program allegedly discriminating against White and Asian students in science and technology fields.

item.title: Trump ally Clay Fuller advances in Georgia fight for MTG’s former seat
item.summary: Georgia 14th Congressional District runoff features Republican Clay Fuller, backed by Trump, facing Democrat Shawn Harris April 7 after Harris led with 37% and Fuller earned 35%.

item.title: 171 million travelers face airport delays as Democrats' DHS shutdown hits TSA staffing, Scalise warns
item.summary: Airports across the U.S. are seeing long security lines as the DHS shutdown impacts TSA staffing, with 171 million travelers expected to fly in coming weeks.

item.title: Former scandal-plagued Illinois 'super mayor' eyes political comeback as a Republican in Georgia
item.summary: Scandal-plagued former Illinois Mayor Tiffany Henyard switches parties, runs as Republican in Georgia after alleged corruption probe and FBI subpoenas.

item.title: Washington parents demand action, answers after teacher allegedly raped student on school grounds
item.summary: A Skykomish K-12 physical education teacher and athletic director has been arrested on suspicion of sexually abusing a student for more than a year.

item.title: Here is how Team USA can advance in World Baseball Classic after stunning loss to Italy
item.summary: Team USA's shocking 8-6 loss to Italy put their World Baseball Classic fate in jeopardy as they await Wednesday's crucial Mexico-Italy showdown.
